Alcohol: To restrict alcohol according to CV prevention guidelines.
Recommendation example: men or 1 unit per day in women.
Immunization: Be aware of the need for immunization for influenza and pneumococcal disease.
Discuss benefits and possible barriers to immunization.
Smoking and recreational drugs: Be aware of the consequences for health of smoking and use of recreational drugs.
Stop smoking (including e-cigarettes) and stop taking recreational drugs.
Inform, discuss and help in decision making.
Refer for specialist advice for smoking cessation and drug withdrawal and replacement therapy.
Consider referral for cognitive behavioural therapy and psychological support if patient wishes to stop smoking or taking drugs.
Travel, leisure, driving: Be able to prepare travel and leisure activities according to physical capacity.
Be able to take an informed decision about driving.
Inform and discuss practical issues related to long haul travel, staying abroad, exposure to sun (amiodarone effects), high humidity or heat (dehydration), and high altitude (oxygenation).
Provide practical advice related to travel with medication/devices (keep medicines in hand luggage, have a list with medication, device name/card and treating centres).
Inform about local/national/international regulation related to driving.
Sexual activity: Be able to resume or adapt sexual activity according to physical capacity.
Recognize possible problems with sexual activity and their relationship with HF or its treatment.
Inform and discuss that sexual activity is safe for stable HF (heart failure) patients.
Provide advice on eliminating factors predisposing to sexual problems.
Discuss and provide available pharmacological treatment for sexual problems.
Refer to specialist for sexual counselling when necessary.
